nodes.label: Sent to the focused app to paste the text.

Types with the current layout, or pastes the whole text when a character is unavailable. Paste requires clipboard access and support for the paste shortcut. Preserves clipboard formats and cancels if the destination changes. Requires portal permission and active-window detection.

The mapper intercepts keyboard input, applies layers, rules and macros, and emits output through a virtual device.

Select the mouse so the mapper can see extra buttons and clicks. Pointer movement is not affected.

The mouse is not fully intercepted yet: a remapped extra button can emit the new action, but its native system or app action may still run. If that gets in the way, disable the native action for that button in your system, browser, or driver settings.
